resolution.note: Root cause: npm run puts the repo node_modules/.bin on PATH so the ts fixture typecheck ran KRN's tsc (error TS2688 Cannot find type definition file for 'node'); audit strips it; regression test plus 5 green runs under CPU burner

title: Planted-records ts baseline typecheck is deterministic under load
body:
Outcome: test/scripts/planted-records.test.ts never reports s-gate-typecheck-runs red-at-baseline in the ts stack unless the baseline typecheck really fails; the baseline run is deterministic (no network fetch, no load-dependent kill).
Why: after #1143 and #1150 the ts stack still went red-at-baseline after ~41 s (under the 60 s timeout) in npm run fast of four lanes on 2026-11-16 (S17, S23, t-2xn2dqs, S15), passing when run alone; every lane's fast is red without a defect.
Proof: the test passes in 5 consecutive npm run fast runs under 3 parallel lanes, and the root cause (the baseline command and its stderr) is named in the PR.
